listing.name: Worldsmith Console Commands 1.1.1
listing.summary: (Starsector 0.98a-RC8): reshape the sector from the console. Create planets, stars (might still be a little buggy) and whole star systems, terraform instantly, found new factions, start total war or plunge the sector into an apocalypse.
listing.aiSummary: Lets you reshape the sector from the console by creating planets, stars, and star systems, terraforming instantly, founding new factions, starting wars, or triggering apocalypses.

description:
Download: https://github.com/tofife999-glitch/WorldsmithConsoleCommands/releases/latest

(Starsector 0.98a-RC8): reshape the sector from the console. Create planets, stars (might still be a little buggy) and whole star systems, terraform instantly, found new factions, start total war or plunge the sector into an apocalypse. Needs Console Commands, LazyLib and Nexerelin; can be added mid-save, not removed.

All other information, like what commands this mod actually adds, is on GitHub or in the Readme.

Extra: Much of the code (~95%) is AI written. My involvement in the code was mostly early on and then some bug fixing, I have tested every command in multiple ways multiple times and they all worked for me, but there might still be bugs. should also run on java 27, with the updated mikohime and fr.
